optimizedContext.value:
# UpdatePersistedSpecOptimizations

## Rules
- `execute(input)` strictly Zod-validates before resolution/I/O: nonempty `specId`; exactly one nonempty `set` (only `optimizedDescription|optimizedContext:string`) or `clear` (only field names). Reject unknown root/set keys, nonstrings, invalid fields, empty/missing/both operations with actionable `InvalidInputError`.
- `set` field stores exact value plus fresh baseline: current persisted schema identity, else effective project schema; every present schema-declared `scope: spec` artifact, filename-sorted, raw UTF-8 SHA-256 + `lastModified` from `SpecRepository.artifactMeta()`. Untouched fields retain value/baseline.
- Missing state + set: base via shared `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()` used by `initialize-persisted-spec-state`, then patch.
- `clear`: remove selected present fields; absent selected no-op; last removed omits `optimizations`. Missing state + clear: no create/write, return no optimizations and `created:false`.
- Apply through pure `applyPersistedSpecStatePatch()`; write complete `PersistedSpecState` using observed `originalHash` or `null` as `expectedRevision`. Propagate `ArtifactConflictError`; unresolved identity → `SpecNotFoundError`.
- Result: qualified `specId`, values only (no baseline), optional `optimizations`, `created` only if newly created.
- Config factory creates resolver → `resolveUpdatePersistedSpecOptimizationsDeps(resolver)` → canonical dependency factory; resolver supplies `specRepositories`, `getActiveSchema`, `parsers`, `extractorTransforms`, `contentHasher`. No duplicate fs wiring; no separate initialize collaborator required.

## Constraints
- Caller owns `llmOptimizedContext`; no metadata regeneration/read/invalidation or LLM policy.
- `readOnly` throws `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` before persisted I/O; arbitrary caller strings accepted.
